included_items.value: One carry-on bag and one personal item on all fares
included_items.notes: Official JetBlue carry-on page. It states there is currently no weight restriction provided the customer can lift the item.

standard_carryon_dimensions.value: 22 x 14 x 9 in (55.88 x 35.56 x 22.86 cm), including wheels and handles
standard_carryon_dimensions.notes: Official JetBlue carry-on page, overhead-bin limit.

personal_item_dimensions.notes: Official JetBlue carry-on page, under-seat personal-item limit.

standard_piece_weight.value: 50 lb (22.68 kg) per standard checked bag
standard_piece_weight.notes: Official checked-bags page. Included pieces and fees vary by fare, route, season and purchase time.

max_linear_dimensions.notes: Official checked-bags page standard size limit.

absolute_weight_limit.value: Bags over 99 lb (44.91 kg) are not accepted
absolute_weight_limit.notes: Transatlantic flights have a lower 70 lb / 31.75 kg acceptance ceiling.

online_checkin_opens.value: Online check-in opens 24 hours before departure

domestic_bag_cutoff.value: 45 minutes before departure for domestic passengers with checked baggage
domestic_bag_cutoff.notes: Current official Contract of Carriage, section covering time requirements. Domestic passengers without checked baggage must obtain a boarding pass 30 minutes before departure.

international_cutoff.value: 60 minutes before departure for international boarding pass and bag drop, unless an airport requires earlier

boarding_cutoffs.value: On board 15 minutes before domestic departure or 20 minutes before international departure
